facts.text: I live in forests in the Philippines, like on Bohol!
I sleep all day and wake up at night.
I catch bugs like crickets and grasshoppers to eat.
Each of my eyes is as big as my brain!
I can turn my head to look right behind me!
My tail is twice as long as my body!
My baby is born with fur and open eyes!
People in Bohol keep a safe forest home for me.

toys.night: I'm awake! Time to catch bugs.

toys.reveal: My eyes can't move, so I turn my head instead.
